goal: CORS review: allowed origins, credentials and wildcard settings.
use: CORS review: allowed origins, credentials and wildcard settings. Use when a server sets cross-origin rules.

steps.note: List the rules. Find each CORS setting and the origins it allows.
Check wildcards. Flag any origin set to a wildcard when credentials are allowed.
Check origins. Each allowed origin must be listed on purpose.
Check methods and headers. Flag allow-all settings.
Report. Each rule with file and line, severity and the fix.
